keyPoints.en: Chemistry is the study of the composition, structure and properties of matter, and the changes it undergoes.
keyPoints.bm: Kimia ialah kajian tentang komposisi, struktur dan sifat jirim, serta perubahan yang dialaminya.

keyPoints.en: Everyday chemicals: salt and sugar (food), detergents (cleaning), paracetamol (medicine), fertilisers (agriculture), petrol (fuel).
keyPoints.bm: Bahan kimia harian: garam dan gula (makanan), detergen (pencuci), parasetamol (ubat), baja (pertanian), petrol (bahan api).

keyPoints.en: Chemistry grew from ancient alchemy into a modern science, giving us medicines, plastics, semiconductors and clean water.
keyPoints.bm: Kimia berkembang daripada alkimia purba kepada sains moden, menghasilkan ubat, plastik, semikonduktor dan air bersih.

keyPoints.en: Malaysian chemistry industries: palm oil, rubber gloves, petroleum (PETRONAS), electronics.
keyPoints.bm: Industri kimia Malaysia: minyak sawit, sarung tangan getah, petroleum (PETRONAS), elektronik.

keyPoints.en: Careers: chemist, pharmacist, chemical engineer, forensic scientist, food technologist, materials scientist.
keyPoints.bm: Kerjaya: ahli kimia, ahli farmasi, jurutera kimia, saintis forensik, teknologis makanan, saintis bahan.

question.en: Give one way chemistry improves health.
question.bm: Berikan satu cara kimia meningkatkan kesihatan.

answer.en: Developing medicines and vaccines; chlorinating water to kill germs.
answer.bm: Menghasilkan ubat dan vaksin; mengklorinkan air untuk membunuh kuman.

tip.en: For essay questions, link a chemical to its use AND its benefit to society.
tip.bm: Untuk soalan esei, kaitkan bahan kimia dengan kegunaan DAN manfaatnya kepada masyarakat.

keyPoints.en: Scientific method: observe → identify problem → hypothesis → plan → experiment → collect data → analyse → conclude → report.
keyPoints.bm: Kaedah saintifik: perhati → kenal pasti masalah → hipotesis → rancang → eksperimen → kumpul data → analisis → simpul → lapor.

keyPoints.en: Observation uses the senses; inference is an early explanation of the observation.
keyPoints.bm: Pemerhatian menggunakan deria; inferens ialah penerangan awal tentang pemerhatian.

keyPoints.en: Hypothesis format: 'The higher/more the [manipulated], the higher/more the [responding].'
keyPoints.bm: Format hipotesis: 'Semakin tinggi/banyak [dimanipulasikan], semakin tinggi/banyak [bergerak balas].'

keyPoints.en: Scientific attitudes and noble values: honesty, accuracy, patience, systematic work, responsibility for safety.
keyPoints.bm: Sikap saintifik dan nilai murni: jujur, tepat, sabar, sistematik, bertanggungjawab terhadap keselamatan.

question.en: Observation: a magnesium ribbon gets smaller in acid and bubbles form. Give one inference.
question.bm: Pemerhatian: pita magnesium mengecil dalam asid dan gelembung terbentuk. Berikan satu inferens.

answer.en: Magnesium reacts with the acid to release a gas (hydrogen).
answer.bm: Magnesium bertindak balas dengan asid membebaskan gas (hidrogen).

tip.en: Never change two variables at once — the test won't be fair.
tip.bm: Jangan ubah dua pemboleh ubah serentak — ujian tidak adil.

keyPoints.en: Hazard symbols: flammable, corrosive, toxic, explosive, irritant/harmful, oxidising, dangerous to the environment.
keyPoints.bm: Simbol bahaya: mudah terbakar, mengakis, toksik, mudah meletup, merengsa/berbahaya, pengoksida, berbahaya kepada alam sekitar.

keyPoints.en: Wear a lab coat, goggles and gloves; tie long hair; never eat or drink in the lab.
keyPoints.bm: Pakai kot makmal, gogal dan sarung tangan; ikat rambut panjang; jangan makan atau minum di makmal.

keyPoints.en: Safety equipment: fume chamber, fire extinguisher, fire blanket, eye wash station, safety shower, first-aid kit.
keyPoints.bm: Peralatan keselamatan: kebuk wasap, alat pemadam api, selimut api, stesen cuci mata, pancuran keselamatan, peti pertolongan cemas.

keyPoints.en: Spills: acid → sodium hydrogen carbonate; alkali → dilute acid such as vinegar; mercury → sulfur powder.
keyPoints.bm: Tumpahan: asid → natrium hidrogen karbonat; alkali → asid cair seperti cuka; merkuri → serbuk sulfur.

keyPoints.en: Store chemicals by type (e.g. flammables away from oxidisers) and dispose of waste in labelled containers, not the sink.
keyPoints.bm: Simpan bahan kimia mengikut jenis (cth. mudah terbakar jauh dari pengoksida) dan buang sisa dalam bekas berlabel, bukan sinki.

question.en: Concentrated acid splashes into a student's eye. What should be done?
question.bm: Asid pekat terpercik ke mata pelajar. Apakah yang perlu dilakukan?

answer.en: Rinse the eye at the eye wash station with running water for at least 10–15 minutes and get medical help.
answer.bm: Bilas mata di stesen cuci mata dengan air mengalir sekurang-kurangnya 10–15 minit dan dapatkan bantuan perubatan.

tip.en: When diluting, always add ACID to WATER, never water to acid.
tip.bm: Semasa mencairkan, sentiasa tambah ASID ke dalam AIR, bukan air ke dalam asid.
